details:
Would it be possible to add an option, other than requiring someone to be the instance owner, perhaps under the “Safety” settings, that would allow players to disable the bee gun, trampolines, and other similar objects?

For example, when someone who doesn’t manage the instance joins an instance with 80 people, and around 40 of them place trampolines on the floor, it can be pretty annoying to have to disable them one by one.

This could also be useful for people who have a fear of bees, allowing them to disable the bee gun, as well as any similar features that might be added in the future. Who knows, maybe we’ll even get a spider gun someday. 😅

It’s also worth considering that these objects can be used for trolling or to annoy certain players. That’s why I think adding a QoL option that allows players to hide or disable other players’ objects through their own personal settings, without requiring them to be the instance owner or a moderator, would be very useful.

This would allow each player to decide for themselves which objects they want to see or interact with, independently of the instance settings.
title: QoL object
